title: NEON ticks from drag and flag sampling, RELEASE-2026: ticks of 28 species x life-stage taxa per plot-bout at 287 plots across 46 NEON sites, 2019-2024
creator: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network)
citation: NEON (National Ecological Observatory Network). Ticks sampled using drag cloths (DP1.10093.001), RELEASE-2026. https://doi.org/10.48443/5e20-3763. Dataset accessed from https://data.neonscience.org/data-products/DP1.10093.001/RELEASE-2026 on 2026-11-05
abstract: NEON's tick survey: a 1 m2 drag cloth (or a flag where vegetation prevents dragging) is pulled along the ~160 m perimeter of six distributed plots per terrestrial site, every three weeks through the growing season at sites with ticks and every six weeks elsewhere; every tick collected is counted by life stage and identified by a taxonomy laboratory (larvae mostly only to family). This table is the number of ticks of each species x life stage per plot-bout from 2019, when the laboratory began counting every tick received; every taxon has a row at every survey (28 taxa). Plot-centre coordinates are as NEON publishes them.
samplingProtocol: Drag sampling (1 m2 cloth pulled along the 160 m perimeter of a 40 x 40 m plot, checked every 5 m) or flagging where dragging is impossible; ticks removed into ethanol and sent to a taxonomy laboratory for life-stage counts and identification (NEON TOS tick and tick-borne pathogen sampling protocol)
surveyEvidenceNote: tck_fielddata lists every plot-bout (with samplingImpractical where a plot was not sampled); a survey is a row with samplingImpractical OK or blank and a sampled area. targetTaxaPresent = N is y = 0 for every taxon; a Y sample's counts are its tck_taxonomyProcessed rows. Taxon pool national.
closureNote: occasion = bout (every three or six weeks through the growing season), indexed within the site-year by first collection date; tick life stages quest in different seasons, so the counts are not closed across occasions; period = calendar year
geographicCoverage: 46 NEON terrestrial sites, continental USA, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico; plot-centre coordinates as published by NEON (WGS 84) in __units; latitude 18.0 to 71.3, longitude -156.6 to -66.8

coordinatesCoarsened.method: As published by NEON (agency-published plot-centre coordinates with coordinateUncertaintyInMeters); no coarsening; 5 plots were re-surveyed by a few metres and __units carries the latest

covariateNote: obs_area_m2 = area dragged or flagged (m2; effort); obs_method = drag, flag or drag and flag; obs_count_likely_estimated = 1 where y includes a larval laboratory count that is an exact multiple of 1,000 (ruling 18: count likely estimated), else 0. Plot-level facts (site, domain, plot type, NLCD class, NEON namedLocation, plot-centre coordinates, uncertainty, elevation) are in __units.
notes: Taxa: species x life stage (adult = Male + Female + Adult; nymph; larva), lifeStage in __taxa; records identified only to genus or family (most larvae: Ixodidae) are their own taxa (E6), NEON's 'sp.' and 'spp.' codes of one name merged. From 2019-01-01 only: before 2019 the laboratory's counts may be subsamples (NEON issue log), 6253 earlier surveys not shipped. Surveys dropped: 13 samples NEON marks lost, incomplete or with an estimated count; 11 targetTaxaPresent = Y samples with no laboratory rows; 7 repeat collections of a plot within one bout (first kept). Very large larval counts: 103 rows have y >= 1000 and 20 of them are whole thousands (10000, 20000, 35000). Ruling 18 (2026-11-06): a larval laboratory count in an exact multiple of 1,000 is likely the laboratory's estimate for a clump of larvae; NEON publishes it as individualCount without a flag, it ships as published, and obs_count_likely_estimated = 1 on the 20 rows built from one (0 elsewhere). Laboratory rows with no taxon (remarks 'Not a tick', 'insects!', 'empty vial') contribute nothing.

notShipped.collections before 2019: 6253 surveys, 2014-2018: the laboratory counts of that period may be unreported subsamples (invoice limits; >500 larvae subsampled to 500 in 2016-2018), so y would not be the count in the drag
notShipped.unusable samples: 13 samples marked Entire sample lost or Sample incomplete; 11 Y samples with no laboratory rows; 7 repeat collections of a plot within one bout
notShipped.field counts: tck_fielddata adultCount / nymphCount / larvaCount (field counts, discontinued in 2019; the laboratory counts are y)
notShipped.other tables: tck_taxonomyRaw (pre-synonymy names), tck_identificationHistory, pathogen and archive tables
